dsh: DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 runtime (dsh headless, the app's own MCP client)
criterion_1: Without any shim, an awr-mcp entry in a DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 profile stays connected and awr_query with child_tool awr_project_status returns the fixture project's identity.

what_ran.step: awr-mcp built unmodified from origin/main at 1880dbda (awr-mcp --version: awr-mcp 0.7.0 (1880dbda); contains PR 614, the merged fix for issue 613) as a dsh-mcp-client stdio entry, failOnStartupError true, reconnect disabled
what_ran.result: dsh headless started with exit 0 and printed no activation warning: the entry activated

what_ran.step: a local stand-in for the model API called mcp__awr__awr_query once with {"child_tool":"awr_project_status","arguments":{}} through DSH
the same probe with the released native awr-mcp 0.7.0 from the npm package
what_ran.result: dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate; mcp-client(awr): initial connection or tool synchronization failed (the tools/list result lacks ttlMs and cacheScope)

shim: none: no proxy, wrapper or modified binary in the path
limit_to_state_plainly: The connection was exercised by the headless profile for the length of one task with a model stand-in, not by a desktop conversation with a real model, and with a build of main rather than a released package: the latest release, 0.7.0, still has the defect. An installable fix needs an AWR release that contains PR 614; releasing is not something this project does.
criterion_2: Recorded in the ledger summary of DSH-004 (owner decision of 2026-11-11: the fix lives in AWR because every host speaking protocol 2026-07-28 hits the same missing fields; reported as originoneai/awr#613, fixed by PR 614, merged) and in docs/dsh-001-l0-check.md
